subject: MAP draft: technical evaluation criteria & owners (CareBridge)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@carebridge.health>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@carebridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T14:05:00Z
Subject: MAP draft: technical evaluation criteria & owners (CareBridge)

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Technical Evaluation milestone. I summarized the explicit success criteria we agreed on, proposed owners for each line item, and a suggested target close date for this phase. Please review and flag anything I missed.

Key points in the MAP draft (attached):
- Objective: complete technical evaluation and gating checklist to qualify Redwood for pilot by 2027-02-01.
- Benchmark success criteria (examples):
  - Generation latency (p95) for 512-token prompt: < 200 ms (hosted), < 150 ms (dedicated)
  - Token cost target (inference only): < $0.003 per 1k tokens for steady-state batch workloads
  - Response fidelity: top-1 factual accuracy on the sample dataset >= 91% (as measured by your evaluation harness)
